name: Mid Night
description:
The Vibe: Effortlessly charming and perfect for warm, magical evenings.

The Scent Journey: A luscious blend of sparkling citrus and juicy tropical fruits creates a sweet, radiant opening. This playful sweetness gently gives way to a romantic heart of soft, elegant white florals, leaving a captivating and unforgettable trail.

Best For: Making a statement during unforgettable nights out or romantic evenings.
